sentences.text: This albacore was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}: {species_rank_days}.
Albacore are long-distance migrants, and North Pacific albacore move between waters off North America and the western Pacific.
By {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began: {species_rank_distance}.
Where it went next isn't known.
